content.short: Phaver is a share-to-earn decentralized social app that rewards active users with ownership in the platform.
content.description: Phaver is a Web3 social Dapp that rewards users with ownership in the platform by issuing tokens to those who share their favorite content. The share-to-earn model spotlights top Web3 content—from blogs and tweets to shower thoughts or product recommendations. The tokens you earn grant ownership in the upcoming Phaver DAO, offering investor-like rights and influence as the project evolves, much like early participants gaining a stake in a new venture.
content.meta: Phaver is a share-to-earn decentralized social app that rewards users with ownership. Discover Phaver and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
